best_for: Listeners on Windows 10 or recent Macs who want lossless and hi-res music on the desktop and already pay for, or plan to pay for, a TIDAL plan.

points.title: The app is free, the music is not
points.text: There is no free tier listed. Individual is USD 11.99 per month, Family is USD 19.99 per month for up to 6 members, and Student is USD 6.99, all plus taxes. Prices were read on the date below.

points.title: A 30-day trial for new customers
points.text: If you have never used TIDAL, you can try the full ad-free lossless catalog for 30 days before paying.

points.title: Lossless and Dolby Atmos in every plan
points.text: All listed plans include the catalog in lossless, HiRes FLAC and Dolby Atmos, ad-free, so you do not pay extra for the better sound.

points.title: Offline downloads are a phone thing
points.text: TIDAL's support pages say offline use is only available in the mobile app. On the desktop you stream, so you need a connection while you listen.

points.title: No Linux app
points.text: TIDAL lists Windows 10 or later and macOS 14 or later for the desktop app, and says Linux is not supported.

points.title: DJs pay more
points.text: A separate DJ plan at USD 19.99 per month gives access to the catalog through compatible DJ software. It needs that third-party software to be useful.

points.title: Only the current build here
points.text: Windows and macOS each list only the current release. The Windows installer is per-user, in 32-bit and 64-bit builds; the Mac build comes as separate Intel and Apple silicon downloads.
